messages.content: PAC Control Console is an operator console for a simulated steam-cycle power plant: an isometric plant drawing, an equipment inspector with alarm response and select-before-operate controls, synchronized trends and an operator log, on one page.

PAC Control Console is an Uno Platform single-project app at PacConsole/PacConsole.csproj (Uno.Sdk 7.0.0-dev.115 from global.json; heads net10.0-desktop, net10.0-browserwasm, net10.0-android, net10.0-ios and net10.0-windows10.0.19041). The UI-free domain (namespace PacConsole.Core) lives in PacConsole/Core/ inside the app project; its records opt out of MVUX key equality ([ImplicitKeys(IsEnabled = false)]) so lists compare them by value. The NUnit tests live in the development repository, noknowscode/PAC.

**Key files:**
- PacConsole/App.xaml.cs: the host (logging, UseThemeSwitching, DI: TimeProvider, OperatorJournal as IOperatorJournal, SimulatedTelemetry as ITelemetryService, IFullScreen over the window the builder hands over) and the one route, "Console" (ViewMap<ConsolePage, ConsoleModel>). The operator record and the fonts load before the first navigation. Debug-only verification hooks (--pac-theme, --pac-unit, --pac-tab, --pac-section, --pac-system, --pac-focus) live in the same file under #if DEBUG.
- PacConsole/Presentation/ConsoleModel.cs: the MVUX page model. Snapshot (telemetry), View (the composed page), Ops, Mode, Selection, System, Range, Compared, Cursor, Theme and the setpoint drafts; one command per operator action.
- PacConsole/Presentation/ConsolePage.xaml and Sections/ (ConsoleHeader, EquipmentInspector, TrendsSection, OperatorLog): one FeedView over View; inside it Data is the ConsoleView and Parent the model.
- PacConsole/Core/Console/ConsoleView*.cs: one pure function, ConsoleView.Compose, builds everything the page shows from the snapshot, PlantOps, the mode, the selection and the view inputs.
- PacConsole/Core/Operations: PlantOps (devices, valves, ramps, applied setpoints, acknowledgements, shelves, the log and the pending select-before-operate command), AlarmBook, PlantEffects.
- PacConsole/Core/Telemetry: Simulation and SimulatedTelemetry (deterministic, one snapshot every 2 s).
- PacConsole/Core/Solids: the plant as solids. PlantSolids is the model; PartKit, UnitSolids and CycleSolids build it; PlantFraming (camera framing), UnitPicker (hit testing), PartSystems (system membership), DepthOrder (painter's order) and SolidBuilder (shapes) read it.
- PacConsole/Rendering: SolidRenderer orchestrates SolidGeometry, PartPainter, StillRunCache, PartImageCache and SystemMotion with a SolidPalette; PlantCanvas and PlantThumb are the SKCanvasElements.
- PacConsole/Controls: PlantViewport (camera in Core/Geometry/CameraRig, FrameClock, TagOverlay), AmbientClock, Charts/TrendChart, Slots, FlowPanel, RangeBar, Pulse.
- PacConsole/Styles: ColorPaletteOverride.xaml (the palette: all 33 Simple roles in Light and Default/Graphite, the file Studio's Themes tab edits), TypographyOverride.xaml (the type scale), TextStyles.xaml (the console's text roles on the semantic styles), Layout.xaml (ConsoleLayout and the layout values no theme has), Controls.xaml (the console's button and segment styles), ThemeBrushes.cs (roles and no-role colours for code).
- PacConsole/Services: OperatorJournal (operator/operator.json in LocalFolder, atomic writes) and FullScreen.

**Patterns and traps:**
- MVUX with {Binding} only. The snapshot feed is Feed.Create over messages, because Feed.AsyncEnumerable ignores a refresh; Retry is the model's RetryTelemetry, reached from the error template through ElementName=ConsoleFeed. Commands read the latest snapshot, view and mode as feed parameters. MVUX runs commands off the UI thread, so window changes are dispatched to it.
- Lists fill panels through Slots, which keeps each row's element across the 2 s recompositions.
- SKCanvasElement draws on the desktop host's render thread: each frame is an immutable record handed over under a lock, renderers are made on Loaded and freed on Unloaded, and a theme change makes a new renderer from SolidPalette.For. SKCanvasElement ignores XAML Opacity, so fades are baked into paints.
- Decorative motion (fans, flow, the live dot) runs on one 20 fps AmbientClock, not CompositionTarget.Rendering; MotionPreference reads the OS reduced-motion setting.
- Theme: the look comes from Uno.Themes (SimpleToolkitTheme). The palette is Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml (ThemeColors.OverrideSource); pages and code use its role brushes: BackgroundBrush (page, plant panel), SurfaceBrush (bands), OnSurfaceBrush (ink), OnSurfaceVariantBrush (captions), SecondaryBrush (soft ink: toolbar labels), OutlineBrush / OutlineVariantBrush (edges, rules), SecondaryContainerBrush (control fill), PrimaryBrush + OnPrimaryBrush (the slate-teal selection and the primary action), TertiaryBrush (the PAC mark), ErrorBrush / ErrorContainerBrush (telemetry stopped, a refused command, a failed save). Alarms (AlertBrush, AlertTextBrush, AlertTintBrush), process states (RunningBrush, StoppedBrush, TransitionBrush, ProcessFillBrush), the select-before-operate highlight (PendingCommandBrush), the process systems, pipe circuits and the plant drawing's Solid* colours have no palette role and live in App.xaml's Light and Default theme dictionaries, the only other place a hex colour may appear. Text uses the console's Type* styles, based on the semantic styles (BodySmall, BodyMedium, LabelMedium, TitleMedium, HeadlineSmall, HeadlineMedium) over IBM Plex Sans (DefaultFontFamily plus a font manifest); spacing, radii and control sizes are the theme's Space*, Radius*CornerRadius, ControlHeight* and IconSizeSmall tokens (DefaultSpacing 8, DefaultCornerRadius 4). System, Light and Graphite go through IThemeService; colours chosen in code come from ThemeBrushes, which resolves keys for the console's theme and follows every theme change (the root's ActualThemeChanged, and a {ThemeResource ConsoleThemeName} marker the page binds with ThemeBrushes.Follow, which also reports a system theme change on WebAssembly) and every palette edit, then raises Changed so the Skia plant, thumbnails and trends redraw.
- Responsive: utu:Responsive with ConsoleLayout (Normal from 600 px, Wide from 960, Widest from 1600); no AdaptiveTriggers.
- Warnings are errors, and Uno0001 (an API not implemented on a head) is an error.

**Simulated:** the telemetry (it resumes at the saved tick plus the time the console was closed) and the operator, "Operator 04". No external service, key or hardware is needed.

**Build:**
- dotnet build PacConsole/PacConsole.csproj -f net10.0-desktop -p:PacTargetFrameworks=net10.0-desktop (the override builds one head without the other heads' workloads)
- In a Debug run, PAC_TELEMETRY_FAULT=<n> drops the stream once after n snapshots, to show the error state and Retry.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
